h1: How to Place A Sheet Metal Order

headings.text: How to Place A Sheet Metal Order
Step 2. Preparing Your Design Files & Getting a Quote

meta_description: Learn how to place a sheet metal order the right way. This guide covers how to prepare drawings, choose materials, upload CAD files, set tolerances, and get accurate manufacturing quotes without delay
monitored_text: Help Center Help Center Sheet Metal Ordering How to Place A Sheet Metal Order Help Center Ordering CNC Machining Ordering Sheet Metal Ordering CNC Machining Materials Aluminum CNC Machining Copper CNC Machining Plastic CNC Machining Stainless Steel CNC Machining Steel Alloy CNC Machining Sheet Metal Materials Aluminum Stainless Steel Alloy Steel CNC Machining Tutorials CNC Machining Design CNC Machining Knowledge Sheet Metal Tutorials Sheet Metal Design CNC Machine Basic Knowledge 5-Axis CNC Machine Privacy&Policies Coupon Policy Shipping Policies Policies How to Place A Sheet Metal Order Last updated on Dec 13, 2025 Step 1. Account Setup Before you start placing sheet metal orders with JLCCNC, it is a good idea to create an account first, as this will help you with a smoother user experience as well as file management. Step 2. Preparing Your Design Files & Getting a Quote To Sheet Metal Fabrication Quote Online for custom sheet metal parts on the JLCCNC platform, you need to supply a 3D CAD file. If your parts require thread, silkscreen, welding, tolerances or other custom specifications, please be sure to upload a 2D drawing with clear markings for all requirements. Please note that the automatic quotation generated by the system is for reference only. The final price shall be subject to the approval of our manual review. For further details on the guidelines, please click the Sheet Metal Fabrication Guidelines. Currently, JLCCNC supports the following file formats: 3D (Required): STEP (.step, .stp) 2D: pdf, dwg, dxf Compressed files: zip, rar. Step 3. Configuring Parameters The quotation page is where you can modify the product parameters you require, including details of quantity, materials, finishes, and more. For more information on sheet metal fabrication guidelines and supported materials, please refer to Sheet Metal Fabrication Guidelines and Materials Supported in Sheet Metal Fabrication . Step 4. Fulfilling Ordering Information Please fill in company-related information if placing an order in the company's name, or personal information if placing it as an individual. Step 5. Submit Your Order Review Before Payment You can pay after your file review is approved. File review is completed in 10 minutes to 4 hours on working days(Mon-Sat 9 am-6 pm(GMT+8)). Your design will not be put into production until we receive payment. When this page appears on your screen, it means that your order was submitted successfully. Click View Quote Status to check your order status. Meanwhile, please reconfirm your order details via the Order Details button. Step 6. Click the "Pay" Button Once your order has passed manual review, the Pay button will be activated automatically. After confirming that your order information is correct, click the "Pay" button to proceed with the payment process. Step 7. Payment Options Currently, we mainly support the following payment methods: JLC Balance( How to Transfer Money to JLCPCB Balance ) / PayPal / Credit Card Conclusion Those are the whole process of placing Sheet metal orders at JLCCNC. If you have any other questions about placing an order, please feel free to contact our online customer service or send an email to support@jlcpcb.com
